# Diddy Kong Racing (US 1.0), recorded by web/record_shaders.sh from web/shader_plan.json in headless Chrome: the
# logos and the title (section 0); the title's demo; the menus from the title to Adventure; Timber's Island; then a
# section a world: its hub, and each race, battle and boss race driven ~40 s after the countdown, the player's kart
# steered toward each checkpoint; Future Fun Land; Wizpig's two races, the second driven ~70 s, and after them the
# party and the two endings (maps 56, 63 and 64, cutscenes watched as they play); the trophy podium; a race's results.
# Each map is reached by web/shader_survey.js through the game's own teleport, a race or hub in a page load of its own.
# Not recorded: multiplayer (split screen), Tracks mode's menus, the other cutscenes between worlds, Adventure 2.
# A world's section holds every description its maps drew, those another section holds too: each is built once.
